sourceText:
Sesame Fried Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 3:49pm

Ingredients




1 egg, beaten
1/2 cup milk
1 cup flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
2 teaspoons salt
2 teaspoons paprika
1/4 teaspoon pepper
2 tablespoons sesame seeds
1/2 cup butter
1 chicken, cut up

Preparation

1 Dip chicken pieces into beaten egg and milk; then into mixture of flour, baking soda, salt, paprika, pepper and sesame seeds. Melt butter in shallow baking pan. Place floured chicken pieces in pan "meaty" side down. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes, then turn chicken and bake another 30 minutes.
